 The San Francisco 49ers were back at home in Week 9 after their bye week, as they hosted the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday at Levi's Stadium and earned a 38-17 victory.
 San Francisco's offense had a solid game, scoring four total touchdowns, and the defene held their own, forcing two turnovers and scoring once themselves.
 As we continue to comb through the 49ers' seventh win of the 2026 season, let's see how Pro Football Focus graded some of San Francisco's best and worst players in the defeat.
 Overall PFF grades: Offense (min. 10 snaps)
 Top 5
 TE George Kittle - 83.0
 LG Connor Colby - 82.6
 RT Colton McKivitz - 81.9
 WR KhaDarel Hodge - 79.8
 LT Trent Williams - 78.8
 Bottom 5
 C Jake Brendel - 64.8
 WR Demarcus Robinson - 59.6
 TE Luke Farrell - 59.3
 WR Jacob Cowing - 53.5
 FB Kyle Jusczyk - 46.2
 Overall PFF grades: Defense (min. 10 snaps)

 LB Fred Warner - 91.1

 CB Deommodore Lenoir - 52.6
 S Marques Sigle - 47.7

 DL Sebastian Valdez - 30.2
